subject.title: feat(apps): rewind and fork a session from native chat bubbles

question: Should native rewind use the same confirmation and authorization UX as the already-merged Control UI before this shared session-state feature lands?
rationale: The gateway contract is clear, but the precise native capability/upgrade presentation should remain consistent with the owner-approved web behavior rather than be inferred by a repair worker.

options.title: Align native interaction with Control UI
options.body: Require confirmation and hide or disable rewind when operator.admin is unavailable, then use canonical transcript replacement.

options.title: Accept a native-specific interaction
options.body: Land direct rewind with an explicit maintainer decision that native clients may expose an authorization error and omit confirmation.

recommendation.title: Align native interaction with Control UI
recommendation.body: Require confirmation and hide or disable rewind when operator.admin is unavailable, then use canonical transcript replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged web/gateway feature and authored the native follow-up.
